old_findings.note: 11 of the 12 short address constants now print 40 digits (0x09f533db...); PoolManagerV300Implementation (0x50a960d5) = 0x0055c00b... starts with a whole zero byte and still prints 38 digits (0x55c00ba4...ce): 'whole bytes' drops leading zero bytes instead of padding to the address width

improvements: Address constants with a leading zero nibble now print with all 40 digits, so they read and search as addresses.
notes: Diff of 85 lines, read in full: only the 11 constant lines change (globalAdmin and 10 unknownXXXXXXXX getters); no other change. Suggested rule for the rest: a value used as an address (here: returned by a getter whose return is 20 bytes wide) prints as 40 hex digits, keeping leading zero bytes.
summary: Display fix applied: 11 of 12 short addresses are now full width; one address with a leading 0x00 byte still prints 38 digits. No regression.
